# llms.txt for docker-mcp
# Last Updated: 2026-06-02
# FastMCP 3.4 — sampling, prefab UI, agentic workflows, web_sota 10806/10807, MCPB root, Tauri

## Project Overview

Docker MCP Server is a FastMCP 3.4 server providing:
- Native MCP tools for Docker daemon management (status, recovery, restart, update)
- Container lifecycle management (create, start, stop, restart, remove)
- Image handling (pull, list, tag, remove)
- Network operations (create, inspect, connect, disconnect)
- Volume management (create, remove, prune)
- System monitoring (disk usage, info, version)
- Docker Desktop daemon health checks with hang detection and auto-recovery

## Key Features

### Fleet 3.4 surface
- Prefab cards: `docker_containers_card`, `docker_desktop_status_card`, `docker_system_info_card`
- MCP prompts + `resource://docker-mcp/skills`
- Web: `/logs`, settings LLM glom (Ollama/LM Studio)
- MCPB: root `manifest.json`; pack with `just mcpb-pack`
- Tauri: `just build-native`

### Docker Desktop Management
- `docker_desktop_status(autofix: bool)` - Check daemon health with hang detection, list images/containers
- `docker_daemon_recover()` - Emergency recovery from hanging daemon
- `docker_daemon_restart()` - Graceful daemon restart
- `docker_desktop_update(full_wipe: bool)` - Fix update elevation errors

### Core Docker Operations
- Container management (full lifecycle)
- Image operations (pull, list, tag, remove, commit, export, import)
- Network management (create, inspect, list, remove, connect, disconnect)
- Volume management (create, list, remove, prune)
- System monitoring (info, disk usage, version)

### Web Application (web_sota)
- FastAPI bridge on port 10807 (`/api/*`, `/api/logs`, `/api/llm/providers`)
- React/Vite on port 10806 (dev); Tauri bundles UI + sidecar
- Fleet pages: dashboard, containers, images, tools, chat, settings (LLM glom-on), event logs, help
- Prefab MCP tools: docker_containers_card, docker_desktop_status_card, docker_system_info_card
- MCP prompts: docker_deploy_stack, docker_daemon_health_check
- Resources: resource://docker-mcp/skills, resource://docker-mcp/capabilities

## Directory Structure

```
docker-mcp/
├── src/dockermcp/
│   ├── api/app.py                 # FastAPI endpoints
│   ├── core/                      # Core Docker operations
│   ├── tools/
│   │   ├── desktop/               # Docker Desktop tools (NEW)
│   │   │   ├── desktop_status.py
│   │   │   ├── desktop_recovery.py
│   │   │   └── desktop_update.py
│   │   ├── containers/
│   │   ├── images/
│   │   ├── networks/
│   │   ├── volumes/
│   │   └── system/
│   └── server.py                  # MCP + FastAPI server
├── web_sota/                      # React webapp
│   ├── src/pages/
│   │   ├── dashboard.tsx          # System overview
│   │   ├── containers.tsx         # Container browser
│   │   ├── tools.tsx              # MCP tools catalog
│   │   └── help.tsx               # Documentation
│   └── start.ps1                  # Startup script
├── tests/                         # Test suite
├── justfile                       # Task automation
├── README.md                      # Project documentation
├── CHANGELOG.md                   # Version history
└── pyproject.toml                 # Python project config
```

## Quick Start

### Install & Run
```bash
# One-liner via uvx (no installation)
uvx docker-mcp

# Or install locally via uv
uv sync
uv run docker-mcp

# Or use just
just dev
```

### Webapp
```bash
# Development mode
cd web_sota
npm install
npm run dev

# Production build
npm run build
```

### Docker Compose
```bash
# Full stack (with monitoring)
docker compose up -d

# Monitoring only
just docker-monitoring
```

## Development Commands

See `justfile` for available commands:
- `just dev` - Run server
- `just test` - Run tests
- `just lint` - Format and lint code
- `just docker-build` - Build Docker image
- `just webapp-dev` - Run webapp in dev mode

## API Endpoints

- `GET /health` - Health check
- `GET /api/dashboard` - System overview (containers, images, disk, memory)
- `GET /api/containers` - List all containers
- `GET /api/tools` - List available MCP tools

## MCP Tools

### Docker Desktop Management
- docker_desktop_status(autofix=bool) - Check daemon health
- docker_daemon_recover() - Recover hanging daemon
- docker_daemon_restart() - Restart daemon
- docker_desktop_update(full_wipe=bool) - Fix elevation errors

### Container Management
- list_containers() - List all containers
- start_container(container_id) - Start container
- stop_container(container_id) - Stop container
- restart_container(container_id) - Restart container
- remove_container(container_id) - Remove container
- get_container_logs(container_id) - View logs

### Image Management
- list_images() - List images
- pull_image(repository) - Pull image
- remove_image(image_id) - Remove image

### Network Management
- list_networks() - List networks
- create_network(name) - Create network
- remove_network(network_id) - Remove network

### Volume Management
- list_volumes() - List volumes
- create_volume(name) - Create volume
- remove_volume(volume_id) - Remove volume

### System Operations
- get_system_info() - System information
- get_disk_usage() - Disk usage breakdown
- prune_system() - System cleanup

## Configuration

### Environment Variables
- `DOCKER_HOST` - Docker daemon socket (default: unix:///var/run/docker.sock)
- `LOG_LEVEL` - Logging level (default: INFO)
- `LOG_FILE` - Log file path (default: logs/dockermcp.log)

### Docker Desktop Settings
For AI workloads (LLM inference):
- Memory: 12GB+ (Settings > Resources > Memory)
- CPUs: 4+ cores (Settings > Resources > CPUs)
- Swap: 4-8GB

# Run all tests

## Technologies

- **FastMCP**: 3.1.1+ (MCP server framework)
- **uv**: Fast Python package manager
- **mcpb**: MCP Bundle packaging format (replaces DXT)
- **Python**: 3.12+
- **FastAPI**: Web framework
- **docker-py**: Docker client
- **React**: Frontend
- **Vite**: Build tool
- **Tailwind CSS**: Styling
